{"number":30,"title":"Docker crash due to a problem after launching a tool in a container","body":"Hey @kdrag0n,\n\n**Describe the bug**\n\nA bug (related to the network ?) causes `docker to crash` when launching the `amass tool` in a docker container.\n\n**To Reproduce**\nSteps to reproduce the behavior :\n\n1.
